analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – connects individual support to tangible rewards (honey) and broader ecosystem benefits (pollination, biodiversity). Sustainability depends on maintaining beekeeper relationships and scaling hive placement effectively.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate – the ‘hive sponsorship’ concept is somewhat unique, but the market for honey is competitive. The focus on local varieties adds a layer of differentiation.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – the campaign relies heavily on assertions about benefits (pollination, biodiversity).
